items.question: Which benzodiazepine antagonist reverses its effects?
items.explanation: Flumazenil is a competitive benzodiazepine antagonist used in overdose. Naloxone reverses opioids.

items.question: Which drug is used in MRSA infection?
items.explanation: Vancomycin (glycopeptide) is used for MRSA. Linezolid and daptomycin are alternatives.

items.question: Trastuzumab is a monoclonal antibody against?
items.explanation: Trastuzumab targets HER2 in HER2-positive breast cancer; cardiotoxicity is a key adverse effect.

items.question: Hydrocortisone is used in which emergency?
items.explanation: IV hydrocortisone is life-saving in acute adrenal (Addisonian) crisis along with fluids and glucose.

items.question: Preclinical testing mainly involves?
items.explanation: Preclinical studies use in-vitro and animal models to assess pharmacology and toxicology before human trials, under GLP.

*PharmaCraft Daily - 15 Oct 2026*

🎓 *MBBS* (Central Nervous System)
Q: Which benzodiazepine antagonist reverses its effects?
Ans: Flumazenil
Why: Flumazenil is a competitive benzodiazepine antagonist used in overdose. Naloxone reverses opioids.

🩺 *NEET PG* (Chemotherapy)
Q: Which drug is used in MRSA infection?
Ans: Vancomycin
Why: Vancomycin (glycopeptide) is used for MRSA. Linezolid and daptomycin are alternatives.

🏥 *INI-CET* (Anticancer)
Q: Trastuzumab is a monoclonal antibody against?
Ans: HER2/neu
Why: Trastuzumab targets HER2 in HER2-positive breast cancer; cardiotoxicity is a key adverse effect.

🌍 *FMGE* (Endocrine)
Q: Hydrocortisone is used in which emergency?
Ans: Addisonian (adrenal) crisis
Why: IV hydrocortisone is life-saving in acute adrenal (Addisonian) crisis along with fluids and glucose.

🔬 *MD Pharmacology* (Drug Development)
Q: Preclinical testing mainly involves?
Ans: Animal and in-vitro studies
Why: Preclinical studies use in-vitro and animal models to assess pharmacology and toxicology before human trials, under GLP.
